title: A shorter command list
changes: Regular members no longer see the 23 admin-only setup commands in their command picker - those are hidden from anyone without Manage Server
The old per-feature config commands (/verifysystemconfig, /economyconfig and 14 others) now point you to /config instead, so there is one place to set anything up rather than two that disagreed

Heads up: if you added staff with /staff add who do not have Manage Server, they will no longer see the setup commands in the picker. Give them Manage Server, or have them use the dashboard. Day-to-day staff commands like /strike and /clear are unaffected and stay visible
The startup log now reports how many servers actually received commands instead of always claiming success
